traps.label: Surrounded by nobody
traps.explanation: Three walls carrying the trap flag and three trap-only floors around the Borg - and not one monster nearby. The surrounded check counted each trapped wall twice (once as a wall, once as a trap), pushing the safe-square count below zero, so "monsters greater than safe squares" fired with zero monsters: the original answers surrounded. The correction counts each non-safe grid once: not surrounded.
